name: Boop picks a face that can say what it means
case: The agent's tests fail once while it works, then pass, and three minutes in the turn finishes well. Boop reacts to both, and each time picks a face that has something to say: an annoyed huff or 'Basta' at the failure, and at the finish a pleased face that says so ('Finish', 'Done', 'Yay', 'Yatta', 'Phew'). It doesn't make a face and then say nothing when a face that can speak fits as well.
why: plan/steering/guide.md: pick a face that can say what Boop means, since Boop only says a take in its face's mood (say.meaning names the faces that can say each); VOICE.md §4
